description: Nullability and parameter typing: a comparison, BETWEEN, IN list, pattern match, negation or logical operator over a nullable operand is nullable while an IS NULL test and a NULL-safe comparison are not; a CTE or derived table before a RIGHT or FULL join is nullable; a column beside an aggregate without GROUP BY follows the engine; an aggregate subquery without GROUP BY is as nullable as its column; elements the analysis proves never NULL are plain; a parameter inside an expression an INSERT or UPDATE assigns is not typed as the column, and one in a VALUES subquery takes its own comparison; an assigned array element takes the element's type, row comparisons type their parameters pairwise and an ANY comparison in the select list keeps its parameter. The ungrouped column case is its own, since the engine rejects it.
